tagline: A Cinematic Digital Deck for the Future of Retail

about.title: A Destination Like No Other
about.description: More than just a mall, American Dream is a revolutionary community of entertainment, luxury, and dining. Spanning over 3 million square feet, it redefines the retail experience.

attractions.name: Nickelodeon Universe
attractions.description: The largest indoor theme park in the Western Hemisphere.
attractions.fullDescription: Experience the ultimate family adventure with over 25 rides and attractions featuring your favorite characters. From hair-raising tall coasters to kid-friendly rides, this is a global destination for high-energy entertainment.

attractions.name: DreamWorks Water Park
attractions.description: North America's largest indoor water park, a tropical paradise year-round.
attractions.fullDescription: A record-breaking indoor water park that stays a perfect 81° F all year. Featuring North America’s largest wave pool and the world’s tallest indoor body slide, it offers a tropical experience like no other.

attractions.name: Big SNOW
attractions.description: North America's only indoor real-snow ski and snowboard park.
attractions.fullDescription: The first and only indoor real-snow ski resort in North America. Whether you are a beginner or an expert, Big SNOW provides a perfect alpine environment every single day of the year.

retail.title: The Avenue
retail.description: A curated collection of the world's most sought-after luxury brands, set in an atmosphere of unparalleled elegance.

events.title: A Global Platform
events.subtitle: Concerts, Activations, & Corporate Events
events.description: With state-of-the-art arenas and thousands of square feet of flexible exposition space, we host the world's biggest brands and artists.

analytics.title: Tenant Intelligence
analytics.description: Harnessing real-time data to drive retail performance.
